p: seven women shall take hold of: When God will executes this vengeance there will not be one man found to be the head to many women, and they contrary to womanly shamefacedness will seek men, and offer themselves under any condition.
let us be called by thy: He our husband and let us be called your wives.
reproach: For so they thought it to be without a head and husband.

branch of the LORD be beautiful: He comforts the Church in this desolation which will spring up like a bud signifying that God's graces should be as plentiful toward the faithful as though they sprang out of the earth, as in Isa 45:8. Some by the bud of the Lord mean Christ.
written among the living in Jerusalem: He alludes to the book of life, of which read Ex 32:32 meaning God's secret counsel, in which his elect are predestinated to life everlasting.
blood of Jerusalem from the midst: That is, the cruelty, extortion, malice and all wickedness.
judgment: When things will be addressed that were amiss.
a cloud and smoke by day: He alludes to the pillar of the cloud, Ex 13:21, meaning that God's favour and protection should appear in every place.
glory shall be a defence: The faithful are called the glory of God because his image and tokens of his grace shine in them.
and from rain: God promises to be the defence of his Church against all troubles and dangers.
